correctness.rationale: Exhaustive character classification into predecessor projections proves the composition bijection. The run rank weight is binom(d,r)r^(dm-r) exactly. Summing compositions yields the formal rational identity for all d,k, including d=1 and k=0. The unique positive simple pole follows from strict nonnegative coefficients; implicit analytic perturbation gives the CLT with positive variance through renewal atom moments. Direct enumeration reproduces all checked small cases. Finite checks are not substituted for proof.
